description: The bundle registry (ENGINE_V3_SPEC 4, CATALOG_BUNDLE_SPEC 7): the catalog bundles a script may declare. `base` is this folder and is always loaded; other entries name a folder (relative to the project root) or live in the store under <store>/<id>/<hash>/.

bundles.name: StickMan base catalog
bundles.description: Everything in catalog/: the stick, kid, buddy, bulky and dog bodies, 195 moves, faces, places, objects, effects and music moods.

bundles.name: Robo Pals
bundles.description: The worked example bundle of CATALOG_BUNDLE_SPEC 11.1: a boxy robot body, a robot dance and a charging pad.
